# Version 4.157.0
> **GPU rendering and font correctness** · Released November 17, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.157.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with corrected image filtering, glyph rasterization and GPU geometry. The stable release adds texture-subset and image-filter cache corrections plus safer mask-filtered glyph handling. Earlier previews supplied path, clip, text-atlas and Vulkan fixes. Managed APIs remain unchanged, and HarfBuzzSharp retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

## Breaking Changes

- **Check Graphite Metal deployment targets** — Graphite Metal adopts an iOS/tvOS 15 runtime minimum; its macOS minimum remains 12. Raise lower application deployment targets before using this backend, retaining any higher requirement from the managed target or framework. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 157** — Updates the bundled engine without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 accompanies this milestone while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Filtered images stay within their source subsets** — Prevents unrelated backing-texture pixels from appearing under minification, strong skew, antialiased clipping or MSAA. Image-filter cache equality now matches its bytewise hash, including matrix metadata and signed-zero representations. ([#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770))
- **Mask-filtered glyphs use their regenerated layout** — Rasterizes the reloaded glyph rather than a stale outline, rejects incompatible mask formats before copying, and preserves full plane strides for clipped embossed glyphs. Incompatible or non-overlapping masks produce cleared output instead of invalid copies or format assertions. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
- **Corrected GPU geometry, clipping and text replay** — Fixes transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles, reflected hairline caps, glyph-atlas selection and stale atlas work after empty flushes. Also corrects convex-path rasterization, glyph replay validation, Graphite clip recording and alpha-to-RGBx readback. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **More precise displacement and Vulkan synchronization** — Displacement offsets use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds. Native synchronous Vulkan submission accounts for fence-wait failures; GRContext.Submit remains void. A targeted device-loss cleanup delay applies to affected ARM proprietary driver versions 42 through below 56, not ordinary successful submissions. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Explicit cdecl imports** — LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select the native cdecl convention, matching existing DllImport paths and avoiding an ABI mismatch on Windows x86. Public managed signatures are unchanged. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 keeps native HarfBuzz at 14.4.0 and has no public API diff. Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing native calling convention.

## Release Candidate 2 (November 13, 2026)

Release Candidate 2 corrected transformed GPU geometry, stale atlas work and Graphite clip capacity. Displacement offsets gained fp32 precision, and native synchronous Vulkan submission began accounting for fence-wait failures without changing the void GRContext.Submit API.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

## Release Candidate 1 (November 9, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrected reflected hairline square caps and text-atlas selection. It also added a device-loss cleanup delay limited to affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m157 with corrected path rasterization, glyph replay and Graphite readback. LibraryImport declarations gained explicit cdecl metadata, while HarfBuzzSharp moved to package revision 14.4.0.200 without a native engine upgrade.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.1...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
